question: Did the original single standby POST, which returned 503 after leader local-root CAS, durably create version 1 with the exact original intended data?

stages.name: bounded-readonly-preflight
operations: fresh exact original root/state/no-symlink owner and mode metadata
finite full state membership/size counts privately; no key/contents before copy
fresh normal server pin and original X230 ABI/source receipt admission
new root absent; selected loopback port unbound; enough space for two complete data copies plus bounded private diagnostics
original root and relevant data full9 recorded privately; no chmod/repermission
stages.output: only counts/bytes/boolean custody and explicit unsupported mode refusal; no names or hashes of encrypted/credential data

stages.name: preserve-complete-state
stages.core: existing source-pinned CompleteColdCopy r2 with public_executables empty
stages.operation: copy the entire original state tree to backup with no exclusions, O_EXCL, nofollow, original held root, exclusive nonblocking directory flock, exact source full9/membership before/after, SHA readback and fsync for every file; retain full manifest privately
requiredNoModification: every referenced or unreferenced existing native ciphertext object
stages.admission: If any original directory/leaf does not match the existing copy core private predicate, stop and report metadata; never silently widen or change source permissions.

stages.name: independent-writable-clone
stages.operation: create clone from the completed backup through the same unchanged copy core, supplying its exact private expected_manifest; preserve backup and original entirely; reacquire and hold the exact original directory flock for the diagnostic, rechecking complete original manifest after the brief handoff and again after the server closes
stages.publicClaims: complete file bytes and membership copied/read back; this is not cryptographic recovery and does not claim Rust/Python cross-lock interoperability unless separately evidenced

stages.name: private-original-custody-relay
stages.operation: after candidate Mac product window closes, one bounded source-pinned parent reads only these three private files via held nofollow FDs, enforces same full9 and original fixture_run_id plus synthetic_only=true/production_authority=false, and sends a finite framed capsule over an owned SSH child using existing alias x230; keys/token/digest/route stay within host memory or new 0600 private files. No credential value/digest appears in argv, env, runtime stdin, public stdout/stderr, or hashes of public evidence. SSH stdin is a private process pipe; runtime stdin contains code only. Receiver publishes create-only, fsync/readback, acknowledges finite boolean facts. Unknown send/install remains same operation identity and no replay.

stages.name: strict-normal-cold-read
stages.storage: native_v6_file with path equal to complete writable clone; no HA config or experimental/fixture flags
stages.network: only owned loopback listener and caller; no peer/provider/J3160 connections; original synthetic CA and node1 leaf with strict DNS-name verification and direct loopback TCP transport, no TLS verification relaxation
stages.privateKey: copy original synthetic TLS key privately with full9/readback equality and close; never output value/digest
httpRequests: one POST sys/unseal using original private synthetic share; no initialization
one GET auth/token/lookup-self to confirm original root principal in memory; public boolean only
one GET exact original intent route, version=1 only; never POST or retransmit original mutation
stages.effectComparison: exact JSON type/data/metadata/version constraints, canonical data SHA calculated only in private process memory and constant-time compared to the privately preserved original intent expected_data_sha256; emit only present/matched/version/effect classification. Preserve original GET outcome privately. A 404 may establish absence only after the original root principal and exact route/candidate admission pass; any unseal/auth/TLS/cursor mismatch is inconclusive.

stages.name: close-and-recheck
stages.operation: original child birth/PPID/PGID/SID/UID and waitable ownership bound by existing pinned Linux process-custody; original5s stop/group/reap/stream closure; all files/sockets closed once; verify original complete data and backup unchanged, public inputs unchanged; retain all original/new roots privately for review. Unknown closure cannot be claimed success or replayed.
